strategy: H1.3 physiology initialization with animal-grouped resampling
status: E126 continuation completed execution/audit without timeout; parent-validation false. Final network convergence and detailed audit not yet supplied.
purpose: Obtain plausible, numerically stable neuron/synapse initializations for later sensory-controlled embodied fitting; modest data overfit is acceptable and labeled, unique true biological parameter recovery is not claimed.

limitations: Static pooled optogenetic/calcium-response statistics, not complete temporal/behavior fitting.
Scale-invariant correlation objective does not identify absolute calcium/voltage amplitudes.
Prior SPSA direction empirically uphill on its own training panel; resampling cannot fix that optimization defect.
Many physical constants and RMD profiles are fixed priors/engineering assumptions, not all independently measured.

proposed_data_policy.development_pool: All87 currently usable animals, subject to renewed identity/QC/genotype/coverage audit; release original29 test animals from permanent holdout only in new explicitly labeled protocol. No changes to old statistics/results.
proposed_data_policy.cross_validation: Five fixed documented animal-level folds; about69-70fit and17-18heldout per fold, never trial-wise leakage. Five independent fits from common verified pre-atlas-fit ancestor and fixed budgets/stopping rules; no E120/fold-to-fold trained-weight warm starts for held-out reporting.
proposed_data_policy.historical_exposure: Existing dataset/test scores have been inspected repeatedly. Resampling is development/stability evidence, not a new pristine test. Protocol/hyperparameter selection on CV must be disclosed.
proposed_data_policy.jackknife: Optional animal-level influence/data-statistic sensitivity after pilot;87full leave-one-animal-out refits are not first step. Resampling cached statistics without refitting estimates data uncertainty, not fitted-parameter uncertainty.
proposed_data_policy.final_calibration: After freezing method, fit one or several candidate initializations on all87; E120 may be an explicitly informed warm start here. Do not average nonidentifiable weights across CV folds. Validate strong generalization later on independent data.

work_packages.name: Data and observable audit
work_packages.deliverable: Versioned animal/file identity map, reason for unused records, genotype/QC, per-animal trials and stimulated/observed coverage, fivefold membership and hashes; per-fold preprocessing/aggregation regenerated using that fold only. Keep unknown identities out of CV until resolved. Audit WT/unc-31 availability and genotype; mark network-only versus extrasynaptic model scope.
work_packages.gate: No animal overlap; support/coverage and missing evidence explicit; no hidden outcome-based reassignment.

work_packages.name: Optimizer/parameterization pilot
work_packages.deliverable: Common pre-atlas parent verification; small named groups of unknown channel/chemical/gap scales with rotating coverage, central +/- trials and actual-loss backtracking. Test one fixed fold/train panel first; no9538-dimensional blind SPSA resumption. Establish matched, numerically verified network-only/extrasynaptic variants before interpreting physiology fits; include peptide levels in full-state records.
work_packages.gate: Demonstrated repeatable training descent and admissible own-state dynamics; known/passive properties remain fixed, engineering bounds reviewed before changes, no quantitative derivative claim below measured numeric resolution.

work_packages.name: Fivefold stability assessment
work_packages.deliverable: Independent per-fold fits, held-out per-animal/pair/target scores, raw coverage, loss vs initialization, parameter/group variability and dynamics. Same model capacity/compute/stopping protocol; heldout fold scores do not secretly stop/select checkpoints.
work_packages.gate: Report distribution and limitations, not aggregate pass alone. CV gap diagnoses robustness, not an automatic veto of useful all-data initialization; no claim all individual channels identified.

work_packages.name: All-data initialization
work_packages.deliverable: All87 calibration with frozen method, plausible constrained parameter set or small ensemble, prior deviations/uncertainty and all numerical/dynamics gates.
work_packages.gate: Full calibration improves without numerical artifacts/nonphysical parameters; label training/in-sample and CV evidence separately. No requirement to improve former15-worm validation after those animals become training data.

work_packages.name: Later sensory/body refitting
work_packages.deliverable: Retain physiology calibration as prior/rehearsal while fitting sensory initiation, sustained execution, stop/rest/restart, then movement and task behaviors in baby steps.
work_packages.gate: H1.2 actual-checkpoint repeated/varied cues, sensory/no-cue/control-dependence and physics/numerics still required; no new behavior training automatically authorized/launched by this plan.

each_run: Purpose and observable: what is actually being fitted
Training objective change and parameter-prior deviations
Development CV held-out scores and variability, if actually measured
scope: A numerical pass is software/solver evidence, not a good biological fit.
Pooled calcium fit is not full time-series agreement.
Rhythmic neurons are not autonomous locomotion or sensory start/stop.
A plausible initialization is not uniquely identified true weights.

next_action: Read completed E126 continuation audit before more fitting. Keep known sampling failures; distinguish execution completion from numerical/sampling qualification.

extrasynaptic_scope_correction.implemented: r_elegans/brain/extrasynaptic.py with packaged extrasynaptic_v1 asset:269 expression/affinity-supported peptide-receptor combinations; positive/negative gains and shared release-filter timescale. Optional older atlas/rhythm forward path supports it.
extrasynaptic_scope_correction.active_best_model: E120 and E113-E120 common_state_replay path have no peptide state or extrasynaptic term. They are network-only baselines, not complete biological communication models.
limitations: Voltage-sigmoid release proxy, one shared low-pass timescale, expression-defined coupling without spatial diffusion/range.
No full monoaminergic/receptor-specific intracellular modulation model.
Expression/affinity constrains possible interactions, not measured effective strengths or release kinetics.
Earlier E105/E106 optional peptide variants failed to establish qualified improvement; their numerical failures cannot establish that the biology is unimportant.
extrasynaptic_scope_correction.implication: Missing extrasynaptic signaling could be absorbed into fitted channels/wired strengths. This is plausible model misspecification, not a demonstrated explanation of the optimizer sign failure.
extrasynaptic_scope_correction.proposed_next_design: Matched network-only versus small constrained extrasynaptic model under identical animal folds/own-state forward numerics. Peptide levels must be part of settling, phase anchors and every trial/replay, not reset as hidden state. Initially small grouped gains; no automatic269-pair strength expansion. Audit genotype and availability of matched WT/unc-31 evidence before using it; UNC-31 perturbation is not a perfect isolated peptide subtraction.
extrasynaptic_scope_correction.status: E122 active fixed-prior pilot executed; E124 prospectively adds bounded shared peptide balance fitting in five independent folds. Server execution not yet evidenced.

prospective_numerical_policy.proposal: Declare full-late and multiple subwindow period/amplitude/waveform criteria before future fitting; keep boundedness/persistent activity, response convergence, source/parameter controls and restart checks. Retain last-five results as recorded diagnostics. Validate fitted candidates at finer/independent resolution.
prospective_numerical_policy.rationale: E123 whole150s mean differences <0.095%period,<0.141%amplitude,<0.017mVwaveform;50s subwindow maxima <0.097%,<0.289%,<0.034mV. Two-grid descriptive agreement supports stable averages, not proof of convergence or biological fidelity.
